newsitem.title: MEXICO: 70 injured in Mexico train crash.
newsitem.headline: 70 injured in Mexico train crash.

text.p: About 70 people were injured when a passenger train collided with a cargo train in the western Mexican state of Jalisco on Monday, officials said.
Police in the town of Zocoalco de Torres, 24 miles (40 km) south of the state capital Guadalajara, said 17 people were seriously injured, but there were no immediate reports of deaths.
Most of the serious injuries were broken bones, including some head fractures, local police commander Noe Mejia said.
"As of now, we have no reports of any deaths," he said.

Mejia added that according to preliminary police reports, the crash took place after the passenger train, with 170 people on board, failed to make a mandatory stop at the town and rammed into the cargo train.
The passenger train was headed toward Guadalajara from the tourist resort and port city of Manzanillo, some 120 miles (200 km) southwest of the state capital, police said.
